en.description:
Epic battles of tiny proportions!

Tiny Armies is a fast-paced game of conquest. Swipe your units to conquer the enemy and strategize as you encounter lakes, mountains, and forests along the way.

Play handcrafted levels, endless random maps, or battle your friends face-to-face in local multiplayer for gloriously tiny bragging rights!

Quick bursts of gameplay with a striking presentation, designed for Apple Watch, iPhone, and iPad.

Invade your friends' message threads with the Tiny Armies iMessage Sticker Pack featuring brave knights and animated tiles!

- Reviews -

"Tiny Armies is a fast, lightweight, easy-to-play, game of conquest. This one's worth buying on your iOS device." - Pocket Tactics

"Tiny Armies should be standard issue for all Apple Watch owners. It places an effortless punch right on the button that delivers a knockout." - The Zarf

"This is the type of game you'd expect to play on a watch. Once you start playing - oh my gosh - it's like wait, they're attacking me! I'm not just swiping. It's not passive. These guys are moving trying to eliminate me. It's actually quite fun." - Apple WatchCast

"One level of Tiny Armies takes a mere minute which makes it perfect for short play sessions. The game is fun and fairly challenging, you’ll need some good tactics to play a couple moves ahead and take down Red." - 5 Minute Games
en.releaseNotes:
Invade your friends' message threads with the all-new Tiny Armies iMessage Sticker Pack featuring brave knights and animated tiles!

Fixed an issue with the Apple Watch version's pause menu to allow players to restart or quit a level.

The Tiny Armies app icon is reforged with Liquid Glass.

Spring cleaning! Overhauled the app under the hood for future updates.

versionHistory.releaseNotes:
More levels! Introducing a fresh level pack featuring the new and mystical Portal. Can you master its magic?

An epic thanks to everyone who's playing Tiny Armies! Let us know if it's a hit and we'll keep updating with new levels and content.

New game mode: Skirmish! Play an endless campaign of levels, scoring points for victories in fast-paced battles.

Thanks to everyone who's playing Tiny Armies! Greatly appreciate your feedback and let us know what you think of this new game mode.

New game mode: Skirmish! Play an endless campaign of levels, scoring points for victories in fast-paced battles.

Thanks to everyone who's playing Tiny Armies! Greatly appreciate your feedback and let us know what you think of this new game mode.

Introducing Tiny Armies to iPhone for the first time! Swipe your way to victory in tiny battles of epic proportions that fit in the palm of your hand.

Thanks to everyone who's playing Tiny Armies! Greatly appreciate your feedback and let us know what you think. :)

Battle your friends face-to-face in an all new versus mode! Share a screen and take turns swiping for gloriously tiny bragging rights.

An epic thanks to everyone playing Tiny Armies! Let us know if it's a hit and we'll keep updating with new content.

Spiced up Skirmish mode on Apple Watch by including some maps without fog.

Versus mode on iPhone and Apple Watch now features turn indicators to help show who's turn it is.

A big thanks to our players who suggested these ideas! You guys are awesome. If you have an idea, let us know and you might see it in a future update. Thanks for playing Tiny Armies!

Happy New Year! The first Tiny Armies update of 2017 has arrived.

Skirmish and Versus on Apple Watch now include settings menus for a wide range of gameplay customization! Select how often you'd like to play with fog, tweak the quantity of tiles such as mountains and forests to your personal tastes, and choose your favorite map sizes on which to lead your troops to glory.

The Apple Watch version now supports bigger map sizes, including 9x9 and 11x11.

Versus mode alternates between Blue and Red going first for a fairer experience.

Greatly appreciate your feedback and a big thanks to our players who suggested these ideas! Let us know if it's a hit and we'll keep the updates coming. Thanks for playing Tiny Armies!

If you enjoy Tiny Armies on iPhone or have given feedback for the iPhone version, this update is for YOU! Also, if you're into games for iMessage, we've got a little surprise for you, too. ;)

Here's what's new:

- Completely redesigned menu system for iPhone with the goal of improving navigation. To quote one of our players, the old menu system was a bit "ridiculous." So hopefully this does the trick!

- Skirmish mode added to iPhone! The perfect way to play random maps of varying sizes and difficulties.

- Settings for Skirmish and Versus added to iPhone! Now you'll be able to customize your gameplay experience, including quantities of special tiles, map sizes, and how often fog appears.

- The ability to replay the tutorial on iPhone just in case you need a refresher, or have a buddy who wants to play for the first time on your device. This could be a quick way to bring them up to speed before you crush them in Versus mode.

- Tiny Armies is now on iMessage! Send and receive levels with your friends for lighthearted fun, or to resolve serious disputes like whether you're picking up takeout or ordering pizza tonight.

Hopefully this greatly enhances your Tiny Armies experience on iPhone. If you enjoy this update (or have feedback ideas), please let us know in a review! It really means a lot to us. Thanks for playing Tiny Armies!

Battle your friends across the world in the all new Tiny Armies iMessage app! Gloriously tiny bragging rights are at stake.

Greatly appreciate your feedback and thanks for playing Tiny Armies! Let us know if it's a hit and we'll keep the updates coming.

We're helping Tiny Armies live its best life on Apple Watch Series 4 and iPhone!

Stay tuned, we’ve got some new ideas in the works.

Have you ever wanted to play your four-person bobsled team in Tiny Armies? How about your piano trio? Well, Versus mode now supports 2, 3, and 4 player battles on iPhone!

Also, if you reopen the tutorial, you can now return to the main game at any time thanks to a helpful little 'x' button in the top-right corner.

What do you and your friends/enemies think of the updated Versus mode? We always enjoy your feedback and support, so let us know in a review - thanks!

Zap! Pow! Whoosh! Tiny Armies now includes sound effects.

Skirmish mode on iPhone now supports battles against 1, 2, or 3 enemies at a time!

Thanks for your support!

The official Tiny Armies Apple Watch complication is here! Add it to your favorite watch face to quickly launch Tiny Armies with a single tap.

Thanks for your support and stay tuned for more updates!

Tiny Armies just got a tiny bit bigger on Apple Watch!
• Skirmish mode now supports battles against 1, 2, or 3 enemies at a time.
• Versus mode now supports 2, 3, and 4 player battles.

To change the number of enemies or players on Apple Watch, tap the gear icon on the Skirmish or Versus pages to open Settings.

Also, Tiny Armies is now an independent app on Apple Watch. *<):D

Thanks for playing Tiny Armies!

Spring cleaning for Tiny Armies!

Keep an eye open for new animations.

Improved Skirmish and Versus settings to keep them looking their best.

Behind the scenes updates in preparation for exciting new things in the near future.

Thanks for playing Tiny Armies!

To celebrate the 4 year journey of Tiny Armies on the App Store, we’ve updated the game with some new features:
- We’ve added a new tile: the Recruit! Swipe one of your units into a Recruit to have them join your army.
- Debuting a new Campaign for iPhone, complete with handcrafted levels to unlock and win, and some new characters to enjoy. :)
- Introducing a new Info page that includes Game Center Achievements and iCould Save.
- Added a wins counter to Skirmish mode on iPhone.

Thank you for your feedback and support, Tiny Armies wouldn’t be what it is today without you. Here’s to another 4 years!

New year, new update!
- Introducing the first-ever Tiny Armies iPad app. Take full advantage of the big screen, or multitask with Slide Over and Split View!
- Added Victory and Defeat animations to the iPhone version.
- Fixed sound on Apple Watch.
This update fixes a swiping issue on Apple Watch Series 3. Thanks to the players who brought this to our attention!
